theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_cp_gd_translated_ball_count
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (S : Finset (Euclid P)) (ρ : ℝ), (∀ v ∈ V, ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → ν ((fun x => v + x) ⁻¹' A) = ν A) → (∀ x ∈ S, x ∈ V) → (∀ x ∈ S, ‖x‖ ≤ ρ) → (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, x ≠ y → 2 ≤ dist x y) → (S.card : ℝ≥0∞) * ν (ball 0 1) ≤ ν (ball 0 (ρ + 1))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
